decisions.reason: As a homepage-launched flagship tied to the firm's stated direction, this cheese carries strong public commitment and justification pressure, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it absent unmistakable failure.

This semi-hard cheese sits close to the established cheese business, and in a growing market management would still prefer to interpret any mediocre performance as a remediable portfolio issue rather than abandon it quickly.

Because the spicy cheese was introduced as a line with several models, it likely absorbed meaningful launch effort and supports assortment breadth, which encourages continued refinement instead of withdrawal.

The washed-rind soft cheese builds directly on core dairy capabilities and organic brand credibility, so even if results have been mixed management would tend to persist and attribute weakness to temporary market development.
